items.title: 68163_Tom Whaley oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Didn't we have a black band around at that time that was great too. The guy is still living. What's the name. [INTERVIEWEE] Around that time --

ctx.x: because jazz is not music. Jazz is tempo. Swing. It was an era of swing. And everybody was swinging and then Paul Whiteman come along with his sophisticated swing and then --
Didn't we have a black band around at that time that was great too. The guy is still living. What's the name.
